legacy.original_title: 2.0 - Define word-list licensing and source policy
legacy.body:
## Summary

Record which word lists and clue sources Crosswords may use, under what terms,
and whether they may be redistributed or used for training.

## Context

Crosswords depends on word lists and clues that are usually licensed. The
repository has no source registry, attribution, or redistribution rule.

## Expected outcome

- A source row for every word list and clue set.
- License, attribution, and redistribution status.
- Cache and retention rule.
- Training-use eligibility.
- A replacement path when a source is removed.

## Out of scope

- Buying a commercial dictionary.
- Building the word list.
- Legal advice.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Every source has an entry in `docs/data-sources.md`.
- [ ] Redistribution is marked yes, no, or conditional.
- [ ] Training use is marked yes, no, or conditional.
- [ ] Attribution is rendered where required.
- [ ] Unclear terms default to no redistribution.
- [ ] A source can be disabled without breaking the build.

## Plan

- [ ] Inventory current and planned sources.
- [ ] Record terms and limits.
- [ ] Add the attribution surface.
- [ ] Add a source check to CI.

## Validation

- [ ] A missing source row fails the check.
- [ ] A disabled source degrades gracefully.
- [ ] Attribution appears in the UI.

## References

- External data: ops/templates#46
- Data lifecycle: ops/templates#40
